ex.en: The company holds a charity event every year.
ex.zh: 公司每年都會舉辦慈善活動。

ex.en: How many people attended the event?
ex.zh: 有多少人參加這場活動？

ex.en: Many important historical events took place 7000 years B.C.
ex.zh: 西元前七千年左右發生了許多重要的歷史事件。

ex.en: He organized a classroom debate on current events.
ex.zh: 他組織了一場關於時事的課堂辯論。

ex.en: The event is still fresh in our memory.
ex.zh: 那件事在我們的記憶中依然鮮明。

ex.en: In any event, I will do my best.
In any event, we should leave before dark.
ex.zh: 無論如何，我們都應該在天黑前出發。

ex.en: Employees receive a performance evaluation every year.
ex.zh: 員工每年都會接受績效考核。

ex.en: The evaluation showed that the program was successful.
ex.zh: 評估顯示這個計畫很成功。

ex.en: The people were evacuated because of the flood.
ex.zh: 人們因為洪水被疏散了。

ex.en: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
ex.zh: 我們只有不到五分鐘的時間疏散整棟大樓。

ex.en: We will evaluate the results at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 我們會在月底評估結果。

ex.en: Teachers evaluate students in different ways.
ex.zh: 老師用不同的方式評量學生。
